activity_records.raw_value: inhibition zones observed after picking SA-positive transductants onto Micrococcus luteus-seeded indicator plates

assay_conditions.method: SA phenotype screen using host-cell immunity selection followed by M. luteus indicator-plate inhibition-zone readout
assay_conditions.selection_context: Triple-layer selection plates used 15 U/ml SA; later stability selection used medium supplemented with 14 U/ml bacteriocin.
assay_conditions.medium: triple-layer indicator/selection plates and blood agar stability restreaking; exact agar composition for the indicator readout not otherwise quantified
assay_conditions.temperature: 37.5 C for A25ts1-2 transduction at nonpermissive temperature; indicator-plate incubation temperature not separately reported
assay_conditions.replicates_statistics: not reported for inhibition-zone phenotype screen; Table I/II report genetic transduction and SA-positive colony proportions rather than inhibition-zone diameters
assay_conditions.endpoint_definition: qualitative presence of inhibition zone on M. luteus-seeded SA indicator plates

supports: M. luteus used as SA activity indicator organism
SA-positive transductants examined for inhibition-zone production
SA selection concentrations reported as 15 U/ml and 14 U/ml in separate assay contexts

source_column_context.table_i_context: Table I reports SA transduction frequencies, not MIC/MBC or target-organism potency values.
source_column_context.table_ii_context: Table II reports percent SA-positive derivative clones, not antimicrobial potency values.

curation_notes: Recovered during bounded worker-2 re-review from local PDF text after XML was confirmed PDF-only and no supplements were present.
No MIC, MBC, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, exact inhibition-zone diameter, or broad APD6 target spectrum is asserted from this 1976 paper.
The local paper supports qualitative SA activity/immunity phenotype testing only; later sequence and detailed spectrum claims remain database-only relative to this source.

extraction_scope: Worker-2 source-reviewed qualitative activity evidence from local XML/PDF/OA package/database snapshots; no fabricated MIC/toxicity rows.

extraction_issues.impact: Only qualitative M. luteus inhibition-zone phenotype evidence is retained; no MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity values are invented.
